targets.rawSql:
WITH asset AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM analytics.v_grafana_asset_identity_context
    WHERE grafana_org_id = ${__org.id}
      AND asset_id = '$asset_id'::uuid
),
connectivity AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM analytics.get_grafana_asset_connectivity_context(
        ${__org.id}::bigint,
        '$asset_id'::uuid,
        statement_timestamp()
    )
)
SELECT
    a.asset_name AS "Asset",
    COALESCE(a.asset_type, '—') AS "Type",
    COALESCE(a.location_path, a.site_name, '—') AS "Location",
    COALESCE(NULLIF(a.hierarchy_path, ''), a.asset_name, '—') AS "Hierarchy",

    'Lifecycle: ' ||
        COALESCE(a.lifecycle_status, '—')
        AS "Lifecycle Line",

    'Telemetry: ' ||
        CASE
            WHEN c.connectivity_state = 'RECEIVING'
                THEN 'ACTIVE'
            WHEN c.connectivity_state IS NULL
                THEN 'NEVER SEEN'
            ELSE replace(c.connectivity_state, '_', ' ')
        END
        AS "Telemetry Line",

    'Last Seen: ' ||
        CASE
            WHEN c.latest_raw_received_timestamp IS NULL
                THEN 'Never'
            WHEN c.receipt_age_seconds < 60
                THEN floor(c.receipt_age_seconds)::int::text || ' sec ago'
            WHEN c.receipt_age_seconds < 3600
                THEN floor(c.receipt_age_seconds / 60)::int::text || ' min ago'
            WHEN c.receipt_age_seconds < 86400
                THEN floor(c.receipt_age_seconds / 3600)::int::text || ' hr ago'
            ELSE floor(c.receipt_age_seconds / 86400)::int::text || ' d ago'
        END
        AS "Last Seen Line",

    'Instrumentation: ' ||
        CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM analytics.v_grafana_asset_devices ad
                WHERE ad.grafana_org_id = a.grafana_org_id
                  AND ad.asset_id = a.asset_id
                  AND ad.relationship_type = 'PRIMARY_METER'
            )
                THEN 'Primary Meter'

            WHEN a.assigned_device_count > 0
                THEN 'Assigned Devices'

            WHEN a.metering_requirement = 'NOT_REQUIRED'
                THEN 'Not Required'

            ELSE 'Not Instrumented'
        END
        AS "Instrumentation Line"

FROM asset a
LEFT JOIN connectivity c
  ON TRUE

WITH bounds AS (
    SELECT
        $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t0,
        $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS t1
),
energy AS (
    SELECT x.*
    FROM bounds b
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL analytics.get_grafana_asset_energy_intervals(
        ${__org.id}::bigint,
        '$asset_id'::uuid,
        b.t0 - (b.t1 - b.t0),
        b.t1
    ) AS x
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        sum(e.import_consumption_kwh)
            FILTER (
                WHERE e.interval_start >= b.t0
                  AND e.interval_start <= b.t1
                  AND e.import_quality_code = 'GOOD'
            ) AS selected_kwh,

        sum(e.import_consumption_kwh)
            FILTER (
                WHERE e.interval_start >= b.t0 - (b.t1 - b.t0)
                  AND e.interval_start < b.t0
                  AND e.import_quality_code = 'GOOD'
            ) AS previous_kwh

    FROM bounds b
    LEFT JOIN energy e
      ON TRUE
),
calculated AS (
    SELECT
        round(selected_kwh::numeric, 2)
            AS selected_kwh,

        round(previous_kwh::numeric, 2)
            AS previous_kwh,

        round(
            (
                100.0
                * (selected_kwh - previous_kwh)
                / NULLIF(previous_kwh, 0)
            )::numeric,
            1
        ) AS change_pct

    FROM summary
)
SELECT
    selected_kwh AS "Total Energy",
    previous_kwh AS "Previous Period",

    abs(change_pct) AS "Change Magnitude",

    CASE
        WHEN change_pct IS NULL THEN ''
        WHEN change_pct > 0 THEN '▲'
        WHEN change_pct < 0 THEN '▼'
        ELSE ''
    END AS "Change Direction",

    change_pct AS "Change Signed"

FROM calculated

panels.title: Active Power Trend

targets.rawSql:
WITH samples AS (
    SELECT
        e.sample_time,
        e.active_power_kw,
        p.capture_interval_seconds

    FROM analytics.v_grafana_asset_electrical_samples e

    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT
            cp.capture_interval_seconds
        FROM analytics.v_grafana_telemetry_capture_policies cp
        WHERE cp.grafana_org_id = e.grafana_org_id
          AND cp.organization_id = e.organization_id
          AND cp.site_id = e.site_id
          AND cp.effective_from <= e.sample_time
          AND (
                cp.effective_to IS NULL
                OR e.sample_time < cp.effective_to
              )
        ORDER BY cp.effective_from DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) p ON TRUE

    WHERE e.grafana_org_id = ${__org.id}
      AND e.asset_id = '$asset_id'::uuid
      AND $__timeFilter(e.sample_time)
),

sequenced AS (
    SELECT
        sample_time,
        active_power_kw,
        capture_interval_seconds,

        lag(sample_time) OVER (
            ORDER BY sample_time
        ) AS previous_sample_time,

        lag(capture_interval_seconds) OVER (
            ORDER BY sample_time
        ) AS previous_capture_interval_seconds

    FROM samples
),

series AS (
    -- Real telemetry observations.
    SELECT
        sample_time AS "time",
        (active_power_kw * 1000) AS "Active power"

    FROM sequenced

    UNION ALL

    -- Insert one NULL point immediately after the last real observation
    -- whenever the next observation arrives more than 1.5 capture
    -- intervals later. Grafana spanNulls=false then creates a visible gap.
    SELECT
        previous_sample_time
            + make_interval(
                secs => previous_capture_interval_seconds
              ) AS "time",

        NULL::double precision AS "Active power"

    FROM sequenced

    WHERE previous_sample_time IS NOT NULL
      AND previous_capture_interval_seconds IS NOT NULL
      AND previous_capture_interval_seconds > 0
      AND extract(
            epoch FROM (
                sample_time - previous_sample_time
            )
          ) >
          previous_capture_interval_seconds * 1.5
)

SELECT
    "time",
    "Active power"
FROM series
ORDER BY "time"

panels.description: Active power trend. Lines are deliberately broken across telemetry gaps exceeding 1.5 times the site's effective capture interval. Missing telemetry is not interpolated and is never represented as zero.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT demand_monitoring_enabled
            THEN 'Not enabled'

        WHEN NOT capability_ready
            THEN 'Unavailable'

        WHEN latest_valid_demand_kw IS NULL
            THEN 'Waiting for data'

        ELSE 'Available'
    END AS "Demand Status",

    CASE
        WHEN quality_status = 'NO_DATA'
            THEN 'Waiting for data'

        WHEN quality_status = 'PROVISIONAL'
            THEN 'In progress'

        WHEN quality_status = 'VALID'
            THEN 'Final'

        WHEN quality_status IS NULL
            THEN 'Waiting for data'

        ELSE 'Data issue'
    END AS "Current Interval"

FROM analytics.get_grafana_asset_demand_summary(
    ${__org.id}::bigint,
    '$asset_id'::uuid,
    statement_timestamp()
)

panels.title: Current Condition Metrics
panels.description: Latest available normalized points from devices explicitly assigned to this asset in a condition-monitoring relationship role.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (
        np.device_id,
        np.logical_point_id
    )
        ad.relationship_type,
        ad.device_name,
        np.device_id,
        np.logical_point_id,
        np.logical_point,
        np.unit_symbol,
        np.data_type,
        np.numeric_value,
        np.raw_value,
        np.quality_code,
        np.event_time
    FROM analytics.v_grafana_asset_devices ad
    JOIN analytics.v_grafana_normalized_points np
      ON np.grafana_org_id = ad.grafana_org_id
     AND np.asset_id = ad.asset_id
     AND np.device_id = ad.device_id
    WHERE ad.grafana_org_id = ${__org.id}
      AND ad.asset_id = '$asset_id'::uuid
      AND ad.relationship_type IN (
          'TEMPERATURE_SENSOR',
          'PRESSURE_SENSOR',
          'FLOW_SENSOR',
          'VIBRATION_SENSOR',
          'RUN_STATUS',
          'FAULT_STATUS',
          'STATUS_INPUT'
      )
    ORDER BY
        np.device_id,
        np.logical_point_id,
        np.event_time DESC
)
SELECT
    relationship_type AS "Role",
    device_name AS "Device",
    logical_point AS "Metric",
    CASE
        WHEN numeric_value IS NOT NULL
            THEN numeric_value::text
        ELSE raw_value
    END AS "Value",
    unit_symbol AS "Unit",
    quality_code AS "Quality",
    event_time AS "Last sample"
FROM latest
ORDER BY
    relationship_type,
    device_name,
    logical_point
